proposals.evidence: Turner lists Punjabi/Lahnda khabbā, Kalasha khāvi and Kohistani Shina khabīnu under kharva, with documented expansion or analogical remodeling in the northern forms. These aspirated khav-/khab- left-hand forms fit that branch. Initial-unaspirated kab- forms are excluded because Turner separately lists a competing *karva family.
